name: Common Species
old_description: Furniture design studio hand-building pieces in Longmont, Colorado
about:
Common Species operates from Longmont, Colorado, as a furniture design and production studio owned and operated by Sergei Parfenov. Parfenov brings a professional design background to the studio, which focuses on hand-building each piece with meticulous attention to detail.

The studio produces custom furniture for residential and commercial clients, including seating, tables, coffee and accent tables, storage, kitchen pieces, and built-ins. Every item is handmade using locally sourced materials and responsible practices, with hardware such as brass locking mechanisms, brass accents, and German-made extension hardware integrated into the designs. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Common Species serves both residential and commercial markets, delivering custom work tailored to individual homes and business spaces. The studio emphasizes pieces intended to become lasting parts of a home and to be passed through generations.

The company differentiates itself through its commitment to heirloom-quality craftsmanship, encouraging custom projects so that each piece reflects the owner's vision. Locally sourced materials and responsible production practices further define its approach.
